name: Tonogaki Tatsumi
source:
First-year student at Mizusumino Academy.

Taizo’s son.
He’s a delinquent student with poor grades and a bad attitude; in fact, his admission was in serious doubt,
but thanks to Taizo’s influence, he managed to get in.
